item.description:
DeepSpy 1.1.0

  • Space: tiles now show category, share of the folder and item count.
  • Space: hover a tile to show it in Finder, copy an AI prompt that investigates what the folder is and whether it is safe to delete, or move it to the Trash (with confirmation and the same safety checks as cleaning).
  • The free space indicator now refreshes on its own, and right after a clean.
  • Fixed: the highlighted tile could differ from the one under the pointer.

DeepSpy 1.0.0

  • First public release.
  • Space: a treemap of where your disk space went.
  • Junk: find and clean caches, logs and leftovers, with a preview before anything is removed.
  • Apps: uninstall apps together with the files they leave behind.
  • Exclusions with browser protection, so what matters is never touched.
  • Empty Trash from the toolbar, with a confirmation.
  • A first-run tour, and automatic updates with Sparkle (no data about your Mac is sent).
